gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cinzel: Cut-open terminals, counters flowing out: Gabarito looks expressive and distinctive. Cinzel, text serif copy, tracks loosely with a modest stem-to-hairline gap, so the two feel like unshaded display over a lighter-bar serif.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-serif-hk: Distinctive is Gabarito, one-nib letters with counters flowing outward. Noto Serif HK, classic serif copy, leaves a generous gap at each curve end under that unswelled display heading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-serif-sc: Horizontals matching verticals like rod stock is Gabarito's distinctive trick. Noto Serif SC, text serif copy, thickens slightly at the sides of rounds under that one-width display heading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-spectral: Expressive one-nib outlines, thick-only: Gabarito looks distinctive on the sheet. Spectral, classic serif copy, narrows gradually from stem to terminal, and the hook is that thick-only display over uncurled endings.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-stix-two-text: Drafting-pen display, counters cut open: Gabarito looks expressive and distinctive. STIX Two Text, classic serif copy, keeps thins only slightly lighter, and the hook is that technical-pen shout over pulled-back terminals.
gen-gf-geist-mono-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega, plain sans copy, holds a one-nib look and a gap at every c beside Geist Mono. And Geist Mono can drop a size; those drifting monospaced letters still hold a chunky midzone.
gen-gf-goblin-one-gf-graduate: Ribbon stems beside thread hairlines, glyphs standing apart: Goblin One looks commanding against Graduate on the sheet. Goblin One shouts; Graduate, text serif copy, stays unpinched and bookish.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-abyssinica-sil: Bold open-parenthesis rounds mark Goldman, commanding and widely set. Abyssinica SIL, text serif copy, brushes a quiet watercolor shift under that widely spaced display heading on the sheet.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Open-parenthesis rounds, letters standing wide: Goldman looks bold and commanding. Goldman holds the line open, while Holtwood One SC, text serif copy, nearly shuts every curve on a wide-tracked line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-balinese: Commanding widely set letters mark Goldman at once on the sheet. Noto Serif Balinese, classic serif copy, keeps a midpoint contrast, and the hook is that open display over a literary line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-hebrew: Big lowercase against the caps: Goldman looks commanding on the sheet. Noto Serif Hebrew, a serif, keeps a modest weight shift through a packed column under that display heading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-telugu: Letters standing with generous clearance: Goldman looks bold and commanding. Noto Serif Telugu, classic serif copy, shifts gently from thick to thin, and the hook is that open display over nearly cap-high lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew: Bold constant-width lines, letters held open: Grandstander looks expressive. And Noto Rashi Hebrew, text serif copy, engraves a modest brass contrast under that unshaded display heading.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Unchanging stroke weight, letters held open: Grandstander looks bold. Grandstander holds a monotone line, while Noto Serif Ahom, text serif copy, lightens diagonals a little under that display heading.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-serif-armeni: Monoline skeleton, letters held open not shut: Grandstander looks expressive against Noto Serif Armenian on the sheet. Grandstander shouts; Noto Serif Armenian, a serif, holds mild contrast below.
